body: Back to draft: needs-rework. Merged with current main the new posted_gates harness fails to compile (VerifyContext gained model_excess); see the review for the one-line fix.

Review fix (0b76f130): merged upstream/main and added main's new `model_excess: 0.0` to the test VerifyContext. The decision file now says Engrave mode skips the region law, so the guard proves the trace golden passes the gate the app runs, not that the gate is complete for Trace. solid_law_goldens 5/5, clippy clean. Flagging it ready for the delta review.

**Delta review (M5, since 4ce7dbe7): ready for the maintainer to merge (after #999).**

The new commits are ff6919b5, a merge of upstream/main (`git show --remerge-diff` is empty, so no hand edits), and 0b76f130, the requested fix: `posted_gates/mod.rs`'s `VerifyContext` sets main's `model_excess: 0.0`. The decision file now records that Engrave mode skips the region law, so a trace golden is judged for depth and not for an off-boundary path. The author reports solid_law_goldens 5/5 and clippy clean on this head, matching the review's local run with the same one-line fix. The rest of the full review at 4ce7dbe7 stands.

Refreshed with main (5bdfc00c): `git merge upstream/main` was clean (GitHub's conflict came from main moving under it); `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` takes main's 18 (this PR doesn't bump). Tests, all green: solid_law_goldens 5/5, golden_cl 25/25, conformance 6/6, plasma_gate 6/6, plasma_post 5/5, plasma_post_refusals 7/7, plasma_profile 7/7, plasma_machine 6/6, arc_planes 8/8, fanuc_post 11/11, heidenhain_block_form 5/5, trochoid_op 5/5, slot_caps 4/4. `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens --test golden_cl -- -D warnings` clean. The full `--all-targets` clippy fails on main itself, not this PR: `crates/app/src/operation/rotary_law_tests.rs:27` builds `verify::Cutter` without the `neck` field that #852 (54ed3fe7) added - E0063, so app's lib tests don't compile on 5bdfc00c. This PR touches no `crates/app/src`. Mergeable: MERGEABLE. Ready for a re-check.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** No blockers. The judging is real: each case runs the production gate code with production tolerances, on the region the app itself builds. There are two notes on what those gates can and cannot see.

Reviewed at head `189f4a10`, trial-merged locally with `origin/main` 7e3c75f9 (clean merge, never pushed). Windows 11, x86_64. After the merge only the PR's three files differ from main. `git diff origin/main...189f4a10 --stat -- crates/app/tests/golden` is empty, so no golden changed.

### What looks good: each case checked against production
| Golden | Gate run by the harness | Production path | Match? |
|---|---|---|---|
| `slot_fullwidth_centerline`, `slot_wide_channel_rows` | `verify` in `kind().info().mode` (Area), region from `operation::region_of` on a real `Slot` op, `model: None` | generation's `verify_bodies` with `region_for_job` -> `material_source::region_core` -> `stadium(a, b, width/2)`; `depth_law_of` = `None` for Slot | yes. `region_of` and `region_for_job` share `region_core`. `verify` is `verify_bodies(.., &[])`, identical with fewer than 2 bodies. `gouge_tol 0.01` / `z_tol 1e-6` equal `GOUGE_TOL` / `Z_TOL` |
| `trochoid_slot_small` | same, `TrochoidalSlot` op | same `stadium` arm | yes |
| `trace_plate_with_hole` | `verify` in Engrave mode, region = `region_of` for a Trace over the finished plate (its section) | generation: `region_for_job` -> `section(facets, z)` | yes |
| `plasma_plate_with_holes` (+ `_mm`) | `judge(PlasmaProgram::from_toolpath(cl golden))`. The guard counts refusals only, and a separate assert requires zero findings | `posting_plasma::plasma_clause`: the same two calls on the op's path; `refuses()` blocks | yes, exactly |
| `arc_planes` | stays in `UNJUDGED` with an honest reason (hand-built posting fixture, no op/part/tool), follow-up #1093 | - | handled honestly |

- Differences from generation, all disclosed in the decision file and harmless here: `stock: None` (the region stands in for the footprint; every rapid in these goldens is at clearance), `cutter: None` (law b2 needs a model, and these kinds have none), `stock_top_z 0`.
- Each regenerated program is first asserted byte-identical to its CL golden, so the program judged is the golden's.
- `the_slot_gate_bites` proves the harness is not vacuous.
- `posted_gates/` is declared only by `solid_law_goldens` (`:27`), so the quick-gate fan-out stays narrow. Provenance comment present. `mod.rs` 232 lines. `solid_law_goldens.rs` is 375 lines, under the ~400 limit.

### Local results (merged with main)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens --test golden_cl` | 5 passed / 25 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --test solid_law_goldens --test golden_cl -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutation probes (local only, restored, nothing committed)
| Mutation | Result |
|---|---|
| `slot_fullwidth_centerline.cl` golden: a feed moved 1 mm off the centreline | both new tests **fail** (byte-identity assert) |
| the regenerated slot program, first feed shifted 1 mm into the wall, judged by the harness | **`Gouge { at: 2 }`**: the gate convicts it |
| the regenerated trace program, first feed shifted +1 / -1 / +3 mm | **0 warnings**: the gate passes it |
| `plasma_plate_with_holes.cl`: an inner-hole corner moved 1 mm (`70750 15750` -> `70750 14750`) | **no findings**: the plasma laws pass it |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. **Trace.** Engrave mode stands the gouge and boundary laws down, so the trace golden's verdict cannot see the path displaced by up to 3 mm (probe above). The decision file says this honestly. "Judged" here means "passes the gate the app runs", not "proved in place". For the trace, the byte-identity assert is what actually holds the program in place.
2. **Plasma.** The plasma laws (cut order, cut crossing, kerf crossing, tip-up) have no geometry-against-part law either, so a contour moved 1 mm passes. That is faithful to `plasma_clause`, but unlike the trace it is not said in `docs/decisions/1000-judge-unjudged-goldens.md`. One sentence there would keep "judged" from being read as "verified". Also, `plasma_findings` judges the CL file as it stands, with no regeneration, so nothing ties this golden to the generator. Worth a follow-up issue if the plasma gate should ever own the part geometry.
3. The harness judges generation-time `verify`. The post's binding gate for slot and trace is `verification_report`'s stock-sim clause (plus the generator verdicts). For these source-cut kinds with no part, the generator verdict is the judge that matters, so this is the right gate. It is still not the literal `verification_report` call.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
